title: Same Tree
description: Given the roots of two binary trees `p` and `q` represented as level-order arrays, write a function to check if they are the same or not. The array is in heap order: the children of the node at index `i` are at indexes `2i + 1` and `2i + 2`, and `null` means no node there.

hints.content: Two trees are identical if their root values match and their left/right subtrees match.
Check base cases: both null = true, one null = false.
Compare element-by-element in level order array.

solution.explanation:
Compare trees node by node. If values and structure match everywhere, they are identical.
Time Complexity: O(n)
Space Complexity: O(1)
